normalization.midpoint_native_raw: (2*k+1)*128; complement2^40-u_raw has the same odd*128 form
normalization.signed_floor_negation_explanation: The logarithm polynomial is already floored. Native subtraction from zero negates that signed integer exactly; it is not a new floor of -ln(p). Exponent raw=e*2^40 makes cmul by literal ln2 exactly e*ln2_raw, even for e<0.

transform.sqrt_sensitivity_proof: Both exact and native radicands exceed (8/5)^2; |sqrt(a)-sqrt(x)|=|a-x|/(sqrt(a)+sqrt(x))<=5*Elog/16. Native isqrt(a_raw<<40) contributes one f40 floor ULP.
